components.name: Secondary Refresh Button
components.description: Bordered 44px action for refreshing an operational status view.
components.css: .ds-refresh { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid #e4e8ef; border-radius:11px; background:#fff; color:#172033; font:800 11px Tajawal,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(17,24,39,.04); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s ease-out,border-color .18s ease-out,color .18s ease-out; } .ds-refresh svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-refresh:hover { border-color:#e8aab1; color:#dc2637; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-refresh:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(220,38,55,.28); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-refresh:active { transform:none; }

components.name: Device Search Field
components.description: Direction-aware search field for names, operating systems, and IP addresses.
components.css: .ds-search { position:relative; display:block; max-width:520px; color:#596579; font:700 11px Tajawal,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-search > span { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; } .ds-search svg { position:absolute; inset-inline-start:14px; bottom:14px; width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; pointer-events:none; } .ds-search input { width:100%; height:44px; padding:0 14px 0 42px; border:1px solid #e4e8ef; border-radius:11px; background:#f8fafc; color:#172033; font:400 13px Tajawal,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; outline:none; } [dir=rtl] .ds-search input { padding:0 42px 0 14px; } .ds-search input:focus { border-color:#dc2637; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(220,38,55,.09); background:#fff; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:#687487; }

components.name: Status Filter Group
components.description: Compact segmented control for all, online, and offline device states.
components.css: .ds-filters { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px; border-radius:11px; background:#f8fafc; } .ds-filter { min-height:44px; padding:0 13px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#596579; font:800 12px Tajawal,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-filter:hover { color:#172033; } .ds-filter.is-active { background:#fff; color:#dc2637; box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(17,24,39,.08); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(220,38,55,.28); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-filter:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Network Status Strip
components.description: One continuous source-identity panel with adjacent device-state metrics.
components.css: .ds-network { display:flex; align-items:stretch; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #e4e8ef; border-radius:16px; background:#fff; color:#172033; box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(17,24,39,.06); font-family:Tajawal,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-network-identity { flex:1; min-width:260px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:20px 22px; } .ds-network-icon { width:47px; height:47px; display:grid; place-items:center; flex:0 0 47px; border-radius:13px; background:#fff0f2; color:#b81829; font-weight:900; } .ds-network span { display:block; color:#596579; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; } .ds-network strong { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:6px; font-size:23px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-network-identity strong { font-size:15px; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-network-metric { min-width:112px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; padding:17px 22px; border-inline-start:1px solid #e4e8ef; } .ds-network-metric i { width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#9aa3b1; } .ds-network-metric.ds-online i { background:#0f7440; box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(22,131,74,.26); } .ds-network-metric.ds-offline strong { color:#596579; } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-network { flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-network-identity { flex-basis:100%; } .ds-network-metric { flex:1; min-width:0; border-top:1px solid #e4e8ef; } }

components.name: Online Status Badge
components.description: Pill status label reserved for current online state.
components.css: .ds-status-online { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:6px 9px; border-radius:999px; background:#e9f8ef; color:#0f7440; font:900 11px Tajawal,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-status-online::before { content:""; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#0f7440; }

components.name: Active Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Current-location treatment in the shared CRM sidebar.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-active { min-height:49px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid #cf2031; border-radius:13px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e83243,#c91d2e); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 12px 27px #dc26372c; font:700 16px Tajawal,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-nav-icon { width:32px; height:32px; display:grid; place-items:center; flex:0 0 32px; border-radius:10px; background:#ffffff2b; } .ds-nav-icon svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-nav-active:hover { transform:translateX(-2px); box-shadow:0 14px 30px #dc263738; } [dir=ltr] .ds-nav-active:hover { transform:translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(220,38,55,.28); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav-active:active { transform:none; }

narrative.overview:
SokratCRM uses one shared bilingual operational interface across Arabic and English. The current system is defined by a fixed or collapsible sidebar, a light gray page canvas, white bordered surfaces, red interaction emphasis, compact controls, and green reserved for live or successful state.

New operational surfaces extend this incumbent system locally. They retain the shared sidebar and Tajawal font foundation, use logical CSS properties so RTL and LTR layouts mirror correctly, and keep task-specific data ahead of decorative or disconnected summary content.
keyCharacteristics: Tajawal is the shared Arabic and Latin interface family; technical addresses remain monospace.
White panels and soft-gray data regions sit on a pale-gray page canvas.
Red identifies active navigation, focus, selection, and primary action emphasis.
Green is limited to online, active, or successful state.
Controls are compact, bordered, and generally 40–44px high.
Light and dark modes preserve the same hierarchy and state roles.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Red communicates interaction or product emphasis; green communicates current positive state. Do not exchange those meanings.

rules.name: The Script Rule
rules.body: Use Tajawal for both interface languages, remove Latin-specific negative tracking in RTL, and isolate IP addresses or machine values with LTR direction.

rules.name: The Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Preserve the same semantic order across breakpoints; change the table's visual layout without duplicating or reordering its facts.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Use the established one-pixel border for ordinary separation; add shadow only when a complete surface or temporary layer must separate from the page.

dos: Do inherit the shared sidebar, profile controls, Tajawal font assets, light/dark theme behavior, and direction-aware layout.
Do lead operational pages with the primary task context and place the main data surface immediately after it.
Do use neutral surfaces and borders for structure, red for interaction emphasis, and green only for positive live state.
Do preserve visible empty, unavailable, and no-match states inside the main data region.
Do retain keyboard focus, Escape-to-close behavior, focus restoration, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't replace the continuous status strip with disconnected metric cards when the metrics describe one shared source.
Don't use green as decoration, navigation emphasis, or a general secondary accent.
Don't introduce a second interface font or apply the interface family to icons and technical monospace values.
Don't hard-code left/right alignment where logical inline properties can preserve Arabic and English layouts.
Don't add strong shadow to every nested region; ordinary hierarchy is border- and tone-led.
